payload.claim: The 'This repo's own form gates' and 'The design record' out-of-scope bullets use phrasing ('This pull request edits DESIGN.md...', 'The delegate adds that by hand...') that could be misread as license for the cell to touch DESIGN.md, CONTEXT.md or .saffron/policy.yaml, even though all three are in this spec's own forbidden list and would be mechanically caught by the scope gate rather than silently built wrong.
